== Dates and names (Oct 2026) ==
=== Missing data ===
* No full Day 2 Swiss standings.
* TheForce.net 20 September 2002 qualifier list (about 68 names) was not dested as person stubs.
* No published Top 8 pairings or game-by-game scores.

=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Older lead used 1–3 November 2002. Decipher home and the 23 October PC schedule run Thursday 31 October through Sunday 3 November. Day 1 had a Thursday heat.
* Results print Johnny Chu; canonical page is [[Jonny Chu]] (redirect [[Jonathan Chu]]).
* A 2020 forum compilation listed Clint Hays in the Top 8; Death Star corrected it to Hayes Hunter (already in the article).

=== Build notes ===
* Format follows the 23 October PC schedule over the August worldsformats planning copy.
